headline: China's Moonshot AI Establishes Singapore Presence and Initiates Hiring
summary: Chinese artificial intelligence firm Moonshot AI is setting up operations in Singapore, advertising positions across sales, product, engineering, and venture capital functions.
why: Chinese AI unicorns are increasingly using Singapore as an international base to navigate geopolitical hurdles and access international compute and capital.

impacts.name: Singapore Artificial Intelligence
impacts.why: Inbound expansion by Chinese AI developers boosts local tech talent hiring and regional ecosystem growth.
